in_sanskrit.name: Mastram
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the mind
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mastram एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mastram is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'mas' which means 'mind'. The name Mastram refers to the one who is the lord or controller of the mind. It is believed that one who carries this name possesses the power to control their thoughts and emotions.
